newsitem.title: FRANCE: French 1997 economic growth in line with forecast.
newsitem.headline: French 1997 economic growth in line with forecast.

text.p: French Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn said on Monday that economic growth in 1997 would be in line with expectations.
"The first half has been slightly below expectations. We think the second half will be above expectations so that the year will be in line with expectations," he told a news conference.
The previous conservative government had estimated 1997 gross domestic product growth at 2.3 percent.
